entries.en: We have booked the rehearsal room for the week after next.
entries.zh: 我们预订了下下星期的排练室。

entries.en: As a regular theatre-goer, she always notices when the programme design changes.
entries.zh: 她经常看戏，每次节目单设计有变化，她总会注意到。

entries.en: The exhibition pairs ordinary photographs with pictures produced by thermal imaging.
entries.zh: 展览将普通照片与热成像生成的图像配对展出。

entries.meaningZh: 三线党鞭令〔英国议会严格表决指令〕
entries.en: In the drama, a three-line whip interrupts the MP's holiday plans.
entries.zh: 在这部剧中，一道三线党鞭令打乱了那位议员的度假计划。

entries.en: The delivery driver parked his three-wheeler behind the bakery.
entries.zh: 送货司机把他的机动三轮车停在了面包店后面。

entries.en: I found a striped ceramic jug in a thrift shop.
entries.zh: 我在一家旧货店里找到了一个带条纹的陶瓷水罐。

entries.en: Her throwing was accurate, but she struggled to catch the ball.
entries.zh: 她投掷得很准，但接球有些困难。

entries.en: Through the window, the mechanic gave us a reassuring thumbs-up.
entries.zh: 隔着窗户，机修工向我们竖起了大拇指，让我们放心。

entries.en: Ticketing for the school concert begins after the final rehearsal.
entries.zh: 学校音乐会的售票将在最后一次排练后开始。

entries.meaningZh: 平局后的决胜加赛〔网球〕
entries.en: The spectators fell silent as the tennis players prepared for the tie-break.
entries.zh: 网球运动员准备进行决胜加赛时，观众们安静了下来。

entries.en: Only the final tie-breaker separated the two quiz teams.
entries.zh: 两支答题队直到最后一道决胜题才分出高下。

entries.en: He removed his tie-pin before handing the tie to the cleaner.
entries.zh: 他先取下领带别针，再把领带交给洗衣店的工作人员。

entries.en: Fresh boards lay under a blue tarpaulin in the timber yard.
entries.zh: 堆木场里，新木板堆放在一块蓝色防水布下面。

entries.en: A loose pedal forced her to withdraw from the cycling time trial.
entries.zh: 一个松动的脚踏板迫使她退出了自行车计时赛。

entries.en: The novel's time-server praises every new director with exactly the same speech.
entries.zh: 小说里那个趋炎附势的人用完全相同的一番话恭维每一位新任主管。

entries.en: The album's title track opens with a few quiet piano notes.
entries.zh: 这张专辑的同名曲以几个轻柔的钢琴音符开头。

entries.en: A silver toast rack stood between the butter dish and the teapot.
entries.zh: 一个银色烤面包片架放在黄油碟和茶壶之间。

entries.en: She wrapped the cheese toastie in a napkin before boarding the train.
entries.zh: 上火车前，她用餐巾纸包好了那个奶酪烤三明治。

entries.en: Our drama teacher chose a tongue-twister that defeated even the confident students.
entries.zh: 我们的戏剧老师选了一段绕口令，连自信的学生都被难住了。

entries.en: The drawing program's tool box disappeared when I changed the window layout.
entries.zh: 我改变窗口布局后，绘图程序的工具箱不见了。

entries.en: She refused to pay top dollar for a chair with a broken leg.
entries.zh: 她不愿花高价买一把断了腿的椅子。

entries.en: A red ribbon held the dancer's top-knot in place during rehearsal.
entries.zh: 排练时，一条红丝带固定着那位舞者的顶髻。

entries.en: A crack ran diagonally across the ticket machine's touch-screen.
entries.zh: 售票机的触摸屏上有一道斜斜的裂痕。

entries.en: Her brother called his refusal tough love, but she wanted him to listen.
entries.zh: 她的兄弟把自己的拒绝称为严厉的爱，但她希望他能听她说。

entries.en: The tour operator moved our museum visit to the following afternoon.
entries.zh: 旅游经营者把我们的博物馆参观安排到了第二天下午。

entries.en: Residents filled the hall before the town council began its meeting.
entries.zh: 镇民代表会开会之前，居民们就挤满了大厅。

entries.en: My sleeve brushed the trackpad and moved the cursor across the screen.
entries.zh: 我的袖子擦过触控板，使光标移到了屏幕的另一边。

entries.en: The trade association invited small publishers to discuss rising printing costs.
entries.zh: 同业公会邀请小型出版商讨论不断上涨的印刷成本。

entries.en: Their folding display stand barely fitted inside the trade fair booth.
entries.zh: 他们的折叠展架在贸易展销会的展位里勉强放得下。

entries.en: The fictional country's trade surplus became a disputed detail in our classroom debate.
entries.zh: 那个虚构国家的贸易盈余成了我们课堂辩论中一个有争议的细节。

entries.en: We drove through the trading estate looking for the furniture workshop.
entries.zh: 我们开车穿过工商业区，寻找那家家具作坊。

entries.en: The residents' meeting ended with a long discussion of traffic calming.
entries.zh: 居民会议以一场关于车辆减速措施的长时间讨论告终。

entries.en: A cyclist stopped to move a fallen traffic cone off the path.
entries.zh: 一名骑车人停下来，把一个倒下的交通锥标移出了小路。

entries.en: The traffic warden sheltered under the shop awning while checking her notebook.
entries.zh: 那位交通管理员在商店雨篷下避雨，同时查看自己的笔记本。

entries.en: Their amateur tragi-comedy ended with laughter followed by an unexpectedly moving song.
entries.zh: 他们那部业余演出的悲喜剧在笑声和一首意外感人的歌曲之后结束了。

entries.en: In the novel, a wealthy neighbour cruelly dismisses the family as trailer trash.
entries.zh: 在小说中，一个富有的邻居刻薄地蔑称这家人为拖车瘪三。

entries.en: The goalkeeper arrived at training camp carrying two bags of muddy equipment.
entries.zh: 那位守门员带着两袋沾满泥的装备来到了集训营。

entries.meaningZh: 以收集机车号码为爱好的人
entries.en: The trainspotter compared his notebook with photographs taken at the station.
entries.zh: 那个以收集机车号码为爱好的人将自己的笔记与在车站拍摄的照片作了对照。

entries.en: The tired triathlete left her bicycle beside the team van.
entries.zh: 那位疲惫的三项全能运动员把自行车放在了队伍的厢式车旁。

entries.en: The tribute band wore matching costumes and played only songs by their favourite singer.
entries.zh: 这支致敬式翻唱乐队穿着配套服装，只演奏他们最喜爱的那位歌手的歌曲。

entries.en: An old trolley bus appears behind the market stalls in this photograph.
entries.zh: 这张照片中，市场摊位后面有一辆旧无轨电车。

entries.en: Troubleshooting took most of the morning, leaving little time for the demonstration.
entries.zh: 故障排查与修理占去了上午的大部分时间，几乎没剩下多少时间做演示。

entries.en: She chose a navy trouser suit for her first orchestra audition.
entries.zh: 她为第一次乐团试音挑选了一套海军蓝的女式衫裤套装。

entries.en: He carried the freshly cut flowers indoors in a shallow wooden trug.
entries.zh: 他用一个浅浅的木条筐把刚剪下的花带进屋里。

entries.en: A yellow tube top lay folded beside the costume designer's sketches.
entries.zh: 服装设计师的草图旁边放着一件叠好的黄色抹胸。

entries.en: A forgotten coin rattled inside the tumble dryer throughout the cycle.
entries.zh: 一枚忘了取出的硬币在转筒式干燥机里响了整整一个烘干周期。

entries.en: Her practical turn of mind kept our discussion focused on possible solutions.
entries.zh: 她务实的思维倾向让我们的讨论一直围绕可行的解决办法展开。

entries.en: She draped the cardigan from her twinset over the back of the chair.
entries.zh: 她把两件套中的针织开衫搭在了椅背上。

entries.en: The student used a plural ending on an uncount noun in her answer.
entries.zh: 那个学生在答案里给一个不可数名词加上了复数词尾。

entries.en: The engineer photographed the exposed underpinning before the builders covered it again.
entries.zh: 工程师在施工人员重新覆盖之前，拍下了暴露在外的支承结构。

entries.en: A letter about his unemployment benefit remained unopened beside the kettle.
entries.zh: 一封有关他失业救济金的信放在水壶旁，还没有拆开。

entries.en: Our case study compared a universal bank with a small specialist lender.
entries.zh: 我们的案例研究将一家全能银行与一家小型专业贷款机构作了比较。

entries.en: The documentary's closing interview returned to the family's account of the unlawful killing.
entries.zh: 纪录片最后的访谈再次谈到了那家人对这起非法杀人事件的讲述。

entries.en: The form rejected my password because I had typed it in upper case.
entries.zh: 表单拒绝了我的密码，因为我把它输入成了大写字母。

entries.en: She wiped a streak of flour from her upper lip.
entries.zh: 她擦掉了上唇上的一道面粉痕迹。

entries.en: Their letters describe the ups and downs of running a tiny bookshop.
entries.zh: 他们的信讲述了经营一家小书店的盛衰沉浮。

entries.en: The attendance chart shows a gentle uptrend after the club changed its meeting time.
entries.zh: 俱乐部改变聚会时间后，出席人数图显示出缓慢上升的趋势。

entries.en: The podcast investigated an urban myth about a hidden room beneath the station.
entries.zh: 那期播客调查了一个关于车站下面藏着房间的都市传说。

entries.en: The local software user group meets in the library's computer room.
entries.zh: 当地的软件用户群体在图书馆的计算机室聚会。

entries.en: Wet boots lined the utility room wall beneath the coat hooks.
entries.zh: 杂物间的墙边，挂衣钩下面排着湿靴子。

entries.en: The park's utility vehicle carried folding chairs to the outdoor stage.
entries.zh: 公园的多用途运载车把折叠椅运到了露天舞台。

entries.en: A pale vapour trail stretched across the sky above the empty playground.
entries.zh: 空荡荡的操场上方，一道淡淡的雾化尾迹横贯天空。

entries.en: In the workshop demonstration, the vatman paused to answer a visitor's question.
entries.zh: 在作坊的演示中，那位手工捞纸工停下来回答了一位访客的问题。

entries.meaningZh: 动词组〔计算机语言分析〕
entries.en: The parsing program highlighted the verb group but missed its accompanying adverb.
entries.zh: 句法分析程序标出了动词组，却漏掉了伴随的副词。

entries.en: The community newsletter devoted a full page to local victim support.
entries.zh: 社区通讯用整整一页介绍当地的受害者支持措施。

entries.en: We found a video cassette labelled with the date of our school play.
entries.zh: 我们找到了一盘盒式录像带，上面标着我们学校戏剧演出的日期。

entries.en: Her video diary captures the noise and confusion of moving house.
entries.zh: 她的视频日记记录下了搬家时的喧闹和混乱。

entries.meaningZh: 恐怖暴力录像片〔英式用语〕
entries.en: The film historian discussed the controversy surrounding a video nasty without showing any clips.
entries.zh: 那位电影史研究者讨论了一部恐怖暴力录像片引发的争议，没有播放任何片段。

entries.en: The video recorder swallowed the tape just before the birthday party began.
entries.zh: 就在生日聚会开始前，录像机卡住了录像带。

entries.en: A barking dog interrupted our video-conference with the costume designer.
entries.zh: 一只狗的叫声打断了我们与服装设计师的视频会议。

entries.en: In our small team, greater trust and better communication formed a virtuous circle.
entries.zh: 在我们的小团队里，信任的增加与沟通的改善形成了良性循环。

entries.en: She brought a cardboard model as a visual aid for her presentation.
entries.zh: 她带来一个纸板模型，作为演示的视觉教具。

entries.en: The lecturer pointed to the vocal cords on a large anatomical model.
entries.zh: 讲师指着一个大型解剖模型上的声带。

entries.en: The gentle voice-over contrasted sharply with the stormy sea on screen.
entries.zh: 轻柔的画外音与银幕上波涛汹涌的大海形成鲜明对比。

entries.en: We recorded the voiceover again because a passing lorry drowned out the final sentence.
entries.zh: 由于一辆驶过的卡车盖住了最后一句话，我们重新录制了画外解说声。

entries.en: In the fictional council, her vote of no confidence surprised even her closest allies.
entries.zh: 在那个虚构的议会中，她投下的不信任票连最亲近的盟友都感到意外。

entries.en: The chair proposed a vote of thanks to everyone who had repaired the hall.
entries.zh: 主持人提议向所有参与修缮大厅的人公开致谢。

entries.en: He tucked his unopened wage packet into the inside pocket of his coat.
entries.zh: 他把尚未拆开的工资袋塞进了外套的内侧口袋。

entries.en: The guitarist added a brief wah-wah to the end of her solo.
entries.zh: 那位吉他手在独奏结尾加了一小段哇音。

entries.en: After the final race, the team gathered for a short warm-down.
entries.zh: 最后一场比赛结束后，队伍集合起来，做了一小段放松练习。

entries.en: A striped sock hung alone on the washing line after the storm.
entries.zh: 暴风雨过后，一只条纹袜子孤零零地挂在晾衣绳上。

entries.en: Someone had replaced the washing-up liquid with a bottle of shampoo.
entries.zh: 有人把洗洁精换成了一瓶洗发水。

entries.en: The architect moved the proposed water feature away from the children's play area.
entries.zh: 建筑师把拟建的庭园水景移到了远离儿童游乐区的位置。

entries.en: Our sketching group watched the clouds reflected in a flooded water meadow.
entries.zh: 我们的写生小组看着云朵倒映在一片积水的浸水草甸中。

entries.en: The tenancy agreement listed the water rate separately from the monthly rent.
entries.zh: 租赁协议把水费与月租分开列明。

entries.en: The uncompressed photographs used almost all the webspace available for her portfolio.
entries.zh: 那些未经压缩的照片几乎用尽了她的作品集网站可用的存储空间。

entries.en: Their poetry webzine published an interview with the town's oldest bookseller.
entries.zh: 他们的诗歌网络杂志刊登了一篇对镇上最年长书商的访谈。

entries.en: An hour of weeding uncovered the stone border around the flower bed.
entries.zh: 除草一个小时后，花坛周围的石头边框露了出来。

entries.en: The boxer left his headphones in the changing room before the weigh-in.
entries.zh: 那位拳击手在赛前称体重之前，把耳机留在了更衣室。

entries.en: She moved her weight training to Saturday because the gym was closed on Friday.
entries.zh: 由于健身房星期五关门，她把举重训练改到了星期六。

entries.en: The essay examines competing views of westernization in an imaginary coastal city.
entries.zh: 这篇论文考察了一座虚构海滨城市中有关西方化的不同观点。

entries.en: The museum's whaling exhibition included a sailor's battered sketchbook.
entries.zh: 博物馆的捕鲸展览中有一本水手用过的破旧素描本。

entries.en: Nobody on the committee would explain what's what until the missing receipts appeared.
entries.zh: 在遗失的收据出现之前，委员会里没有人肯说明事情的真相。

entries.en: The wind pushed our empty wheelie bin halfway down the driveway.
entries.zh: 风把我们空空的带轮垃圾箱吹到了车道中段。

entries.en: The detective soon discovered wheels within wheels behind the apparently simple quarrel.
entries.zh: 侦探很快发现，这场看似简单的争吵背后存在错综复杂的情况。

entries.en: The play explores the personal cost of whistle-blowing through one factory worker's story.
entries.zh: 这部戏通过一名工厂工人的故事，探讨了揭发行为的个人代价。

entries.en: Her research on whistleblowing draws on interviews rather than newspaper accounts.
entries.zh: 她关于揭发行为的研究依据访谈，而非报纸报道。

entries.en: Their white wedding took place in a small garden behind the family home.
entries.zh: 他们在家宅后面的一座小花园里举行了新娘身穿白婚纱的婚礼。

entries.en: After years of wholesaling, he opened a shop where customers could buy single items.
entries.zh: 从事批发多年后，他开了一家商店，顾客可以在那里单件购买商品。

entries.en: The fictional firm's wholly-owned subsidiary occupied just two rooms above a bakery.
entries.zh: 那家虚构公司的全资附属公司只占用了面包店楼上的两个房间。

entries.en: The novel's charming wide boy sells promises that he never intends to keep.
entries.zh: 小说中那个讨人喜欢的骗子向人兜售自己根本不打算兑现的承诺。

entries.en: We spent the rainy afternoon window shopping without carrying home a single bag.
entries.zh: 那个下雨的下午，我们只看不买，回家时一个购物袋也没拿。

entries.en: The workers dismissed the fresh paint as window-dressing while the roof still leaked.
entries.zh: 屋顶仍然漏雨，工人们认为新刷的油漆只是装门面。

entries.en: A single wine glass remained on the table after the guests left.
entries.zh: 客人离开后，桌上还留着一个酒杯。

entries.en: Our wing back waited beside the football pitch while the coach checked his boots.
entries.zh: 教练检查他的球鞋时，我们的边卫在足球场边等着。

entries.en: The photographer packed a separate case for her winter sports assignment.
entries.zh: 那位摄影师为冬季运动拍摄任务单独收拾了一个箱子。

entries.meaningZh: 向路过女子吹的轻佻口哨〔冒犯性〕
entries.en: She ignored the stranger's wolf-whistle and continued talking to her friend.
entries.zh: 她没有理会那个陌生人轻佻的口哨，继续与朋友交谈。

entries.en: Three women stayed behind to fold the costumes after the performance.
entries.zh: 演出结束后，三名女子留下来叠演出服。

entries.en: His interest in wood carving began during a summer workshop.
entries.zh: 他对木刻的兴趣始于一次夏季工作坊。

entries.en: A layer of woodchip covered the muddy patch beside the shed.
entries.zh: 棚屋旁的泥地上覆盖着一层木屑。

entries.en: He divided his work week between the studio and the community theatre.
entries.zh: 他把一周的工作时间分配给了工作室和社区剧院。

entries.en: The factory's work-in-progress filled three marked shelves beside the assembly area.
entries.zh: 工厂的在制品放满了装配区旁三个带标记的架子。

entries.en: She mentioned work-life balance when explaining why she had declined the promotion.
entries.zh: 她在解释自己为何拒绝升职时，提到了工作与生活的平衡。

entries.en: The accountant questioned the write-up of the building's value in the draft accounts.
entries.zh: 会计对账目草稿中增记那栋建筑账面价值的做法提出了质疑。

entries.en: The referee reached into his pocket, then left the yellow card there.
entries.zh: 裁判把手伸进口袋，随后没有拿出黄牌。

entries.en: A fresh yellow line followed the curve of the kerb outside the bakery.
entries.zh: 面包店外，一条新画的限停黄线沿着路缘弯曲延伸。

entries.en: The club wanted young blood, but its newest members also wanted a voice.
entries.zh: 俱乐部希望注入新鲜血液，但新来的成员也希望有发言权。

entries.en: The youth club borrowed our folding tables for its craft evening.
entries.zh: 青年俱乐部借了我们的折叠桌，举办手工之夜。

entries.en: She copied the address carefully but left out the zip code.
entries.zh: 她仔细抄下了地址，却漏掉了邮政编码。

entries.en: A couple celebrating their fortieth wedding anniversary sat beside us.
entries.zh: 一对庆祝结婚四十周年的夫妇坐在我们旁边。

entries.en: The report compares the fictional town's proposals with those of the central government.
entries.zh: 报告比较了那个虚构城镇与中央政府各自提出的建议。

entries.en: She brought an album of photographs taken in the Far East to our discussion group.
entries.zh: 她带了一本相册来参加我们的讨论小组，里面的照片是在远东拍摄的。

entries.en: Rain blurred the photograph on the newspaper's front page.
entries.zh: 雨水弄模糊了报纸头版上的照片。

entries.en: We followed the narrow channel until it rejoined the river's main stream.
entries.zh: 我们沿着那条狭窄的水道前行，直到它重新汇入河流的干流。

entries.en: His lecture notes on the Middle Ages lay beneath a pile of theatre programmes.
entries.zh: 他关于中世纪的讲座笔记放在一叠剧院节目单下面。

entries.en: The letter mentioned tax relief, but the damaged final page was unreadable.
entries.zh: 信中提到了税收减免，但受损的最后一页已经无法辨认。

entries.en: Two volunteers stayed at the desk while the rest carried boxes upstairs.
entries.zh: 两名志愿者留在桌旁，其余的人把箱子搬到了楼上。

entries.en: He pulled his track suit over his racing kit while waiting for the next event.
entries.zh: 等待下一个项目时，他把径赛服套在了比赛服外面。

entries.en: The restorer removed the A battery before photographing the old radio's interior.
entries.zh: 修复师在拍摄那台旧收音机的内部之前，取出了A电池组。

entries.en: A handwritten note beside the radio mentioned a missing B battery.
entries.zh: 收音机旁边的一张手写便条提到了一个缺失的B电池组。

entries.en: The archivist found a bill of particulars folded inside the old civil case file.
entries.zh: 档案管理员在那份旧民事案件档案中发现了一张折起来的索赔清单。

entries.en: In the detective story, a Black Maria waits outside the courthouse in heavy rain.
entries.zh: 在那个侦探故事中，一辆囚车冒着大雨等在法院外面。

entries.en: Her handwritten reading on the Brix scale was too faint to decipher.
entries.zh: 她手写的布里糖度标度读数太淡了，无法辨认。

entries.en: The lecturer paused beside an old chart of the Cambrian Period.
entries.zh: 讲师在一张关于寒武纪的旧图表旁停了下来。

entries.en: His cell phone vibrated beneath a stack of library books.
entries.zh: 他的手机在一叠图书馆的书下面振动着。

entries.en: She marked the calculated roots on the complex plane in green.
entries.zh: 她用绿色在复数平面上标出了算得的根。

entries.en: The musician packed a contact microphone beside the cables in her case.
entries.zh: 那位音乐家把一个接触微音器放进箱子里，搁在电缆旁边。

entries.en: The documentary examines an old contempt of Congress case through private correspondence.
entries.zh: 那部纪录片通过私人信件考察了一起旧时的藐视国会罪案件。

entries.en: The student traced the F layer in blue on her ionosphere diagram.
entries.zh: 那个学生在自己的电离层示意图上，用蓝色描出了F层。

entries.meaningZh: 美国联邦通讯委员会〔机构名〕
entries.en: At the library, he requested correspondence from the Federal Communications Commission for his project.
entries.zh: 他在图书馆申请查阅美国联邦通讯委员会的信件，用于自己的项目。

entries.en: On the workshop bench stood a small model of a Francis turbine.
entries.zh: 作坊的工作台上放着一个小型法氏水轮机模型。

entries.en: The craftsperson chose German silver for the clasp on the leather case.
entries.zh: 工匠选用德银制作那个皮盒的搭扣。

entries.en: She circled the grace period mentioned in the invoice and asked for clarification.
entries.zh: 她圈出了发票上提到的宽限期，并要求对方说明清楚。

entries.meaningZh: 图形标准规划委员会〔美国计算机协会机构缩写〕
entries.en: The librarian located an old letter addressed to GSPC among the computing archives.
entries.zh: 图书馆员在计算机文献档案中找到了一封写给图形标准规划委员会的旧信。

entries.en: The software displayed the Latin alphabet beside the unfamiliar script for comparison.
entries.zh: 软件把拉丁字母表显示在那种不熟悉的文字旁边，以供比较。

entries.en: He coloured each row of the Latin square before checking his arrangement.
entries.zh: 他先给拉丁方的每一行涂色，再检查自己的排列。

entries.en: Her pencil paused at the centre of the lemniscate she was drawing.
entries.zh: 她的铅笔停在了正在画的那条双纽线的中心。

entries.en: The simulation stored two sample paths of the Markov process in separate files.
entries.zh: 模拟程序把那个马尔可夫过程的两条样本路径保存在不同文件中。

entries.meaningZh: 梅森奈特纤维板〔注册商品名〕
entries.en: The stage designer used a leftover sheet of Masonite for the model's base.
entries.zh: 舞台设计师用一块剩余的梅森奈特纤维板制作了模型的底座。

entries.en: Her notes confused a millirem with a rem, so she checked the unit table.
entries.zh: 她的笔记把毫雷姆与雷姆混淆了，于是她核对了单位表。
